backchannels.direction: Krama nggih/inggih shows polite listening; ngoko hooh, he'em only with peers; iya iya wis sounds dismissive.

reactions.direction: Lho, tenane? or Mosok to? for surprise; ndherek prihatin for sympathy; waduh for a snag.

cant_hear.direction: Say the voice isn't clear (swantenipun mboten cetha) or the signal breaks; ask politely for banter.

examples.text: Nyuwun sewu, swantenipun mboten patos cetha.

ask_repeat.direction: Pripun? in krama, piye? in ngoko asks for a replay; get the asma spelled out and echo the nomer.

who_is_calling.direction: Krama sinten asks who politely; ngoko sapa only with familiar callers.

examples.text: Nyuwun sewu, menika saking sinten nggih?

wrong_number.direction: Say salah nomer, with nyuwun pangapunten, and that nobody so named is here.

examples.text: Mriki mboten wonten ingkang asmanipun makaten.

relay.direction: Krama aturaken / sampekaken says {owner} will be told; leave out any reply time.

sales_decline.direction: Matur nuwun first, then mboten minat; Javanese avoid a sharp no and soften with nggih.

examples.text: Sampun, matur nuwun, mboten perlu nggih.

firm_no.direction: Second push: recall the earlier refusal in krama and ask that this nomer be dipunbusak.

examples.text: Sampun nelpon nomer menika malih nggih.
Nomer menika mugi dipunbusak saking dhaftar.

address_forms.direction: Panjenengan for strangers; Pakdhe/Budhe for elders, Dhik or Le for the young; ngoko kowe only with intimates.

avoid_service_phrases.direction: Krama lines like Wonten ingkang saged kula biyantu? sound like a layanan pelanggan desk.

examples.text: Matur nuwun sampun ngubungi layanan pelanggan kami.
Telpon panjenengan wigati sanget kagem kami.

taboo_on_phone.direction: Ngoko kowe to elders or strangers, or asking religion or pay early, breaks unggah-ungguh.

uncertain: Support basis: Bageo lists jv in 附件_15_各語言講電話小動作.json (field languages) and 附件_14_地區第二語言補組合.json (field supported_languages); Gemini Live's official language table does not list Javanese
Krama vs ngoko choice depends on age and status the AI cannot see; krama used as safe default
Many Javanese speakers switch to Indonesian with unknown callers; frequency of that switch is unknown
Backchannels (nggih, inggih, hooh, he'em) from dictionaries and usage, no call corpus
